github.copilot.chat.testGeneration.instr.text: Always write tests through the Deep Module's public entry point (the interface is the test surface). Never mock internal private subfolder files. Follow Red-Green-Refactor TDD.

github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Use conventional commit format: <type>(<JIRA-KEY>): <description> [ADR-NNNN]. Types: feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore, perf, ci. Always reference the Jira key and governing ADR ID when applicable.
